lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data for January 2022 medium-term projections were compiled into a GeoJSON dataset representing spatial distribution of food insecurity phases across Nicaragua.
